## Projects

- VOLUME — VOLUME's official website and CMS — immersive animations via Framer Motion and GSAP, with a drag-and-drop admin dashboard. (Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB) — https://www.volume.in/

- FarazPsd Portfolio — A responsive portfolio website for a creative designer, showcasing work, skills, and contact information. (Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS) — https://farazpsd.vercel.app/

- Find My Tutor India — A tutor discovery website with tutor profiles, search, and an admin panel to manage listings and platform operations. (Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, MongoDB) — https://findmytutorindia.com/
- MyBudgetory — Personal finance tracker with transaction management, monthly analytics, and automated WhatsApp debt reminders. (Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB) — https://mybudgetory.vercel.app/
- TrackR — Platform for reporting and reclaiming lost items — location-based search, admin moderation, secure auth. (Node.js, React, MongoDB, Express) — https://github.com/justtayyabkhxn/TrackR
- Sticko — Notes and to-do PWA with task management and data export, fully responsive and offline-capable. (Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB) — https://stickonotes.vercel.app/
- Pomero — Pomodoro timer with customisable intervals, task tracking, and progress reports. (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) — https://justtayyabkhxn.github.io/pomero/
- Instant QR Code Generator — Instant QR code generator for URLs and text, with optional account-based customisation. (Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, JWT) — https://myqr-gen.vercel.app/
